blocks.text: 9631 HAZEL STREET Chilliwack Proper East Chilliwack V2P 5N8

parts.t: Discover this delightful 4-bed, 1-bath home on an 8146 sqft lot. Thoughtful layout maximizes space, with generously sized rooms. Updates include fresh paint, new flooring, remodeled bathroom, modern kitchen, new appliances, and advanced sump pump system. Enjoy a detached workshop, spacious patio, and pet-friendly yard. Move-in ready, ample parking for 6 cars + RV. Walking distance to schools, Kinsmen Park, shops, and more. Your harmonious blend of comfort and convenience awaits!
